Hi Elena + Nebula team —

Thanks for agreeing to run a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with us as part of the evaluation. I wanted to introduce the Redwood side and propose owners for the security/compliance lanes so we can align quickly. Attached is a draft MAP and a short SOC 2 evidence checklist to help scope the asks.

High-level ask: confirm internal Nebula owners for the items below and tell us any preferred timelines or constrained windows for audits/POCs. Our target is a three-week evaluation cadence starting next week, but flexible to your calendar.

Redwood owners (proposed)
- GRC / Compliance lead: Vivek Kulkarni — primary contact for scope & MAP tracking
- Evidence owner: Mina Haddad — will collect artifacts and coordinate evidence lanes
- Data handling / engineering POC: Karthik Iyer — S3/network/ingress controls & retention
- Executive sponsor / contract questions: Laura Bennett — procurement & SLA exceptions

Please reply with: (1) Nebula owner names & emails for GRC, Evidence, and Data Handling, (2) any restrictions on what we can request (e.g., can we access test buckets?), and (3) your preferred kickoff slot (I proposed a calendar link in a follow-up).

Attachments: redwood_map_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), soc2-evidence-checklist.pdf

Looking forward — we’ll keep asks minimal and map to your existing artifacts when possible.

— Vivek Kulkarni

Nebula owners (confirmed)
- GRC / Compliance lead: Elena Park <elena.park@nebulacorp.com>
- SecOps / Evidence intake: James Alvarado <james.alvarado@nebulacorp.com>

Quick notes:

- Timeline: we prefer a 3-week MAP but request that heavy artifact requests avoid Aug 9–13 audit blackout.

I’ve looped James and Nadia here — James will triage evidence intake and Nadia will handle procurement items. Proposed kickoff: please send 60–90 minute options next couple days.

Elena / James —

Appreciate the quick confirmation and the heads-up on the audit window. A couple of practical items from the evidence lane perspective:

- I attached an evidence_timeline_template.xlsx to show the pieces we typically request per SOC 2 category (policies, access lists, config screenshots, change logs). If you can populate the test-bucket path and a primary evidence drop location that helps.
- For data handling we’ll need: retention policy (document + config), an example S3 bucket policy (read-only preferred), and a short description of any customer-data redaction/PII handling pipelines.
- If Nebula has a dedicated compliance Slack channel or PagerDuty escalation we should be added for faster triage during collection.

Example ask cadence (to set expectations):
1) MAP Week 1 — discovery & scope confirmation; we will send a lightweight evidence request set (requested items typically ~8–12 docs).
2) MAP Week 2 — evidence collection & clarifying Qs.
3) MAP Week 3 — evaluation, follow-ups, and internal review.

Happy to be the direct intake; cc’ing Karthik for any deep infra/permissions coordination.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
